expectations.text: States 24 of 27 Member States have transposed; the outstanding ones are France and Ireland (draft laws pending) and Spain (bill stalled)
expectations.evidence: "24 of the 27 EU Member States have now transposed... France: draft law still pending. Ireland: draft law still pending. Spain: the bill has stalled."

expectations.text: States the Commission referred Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, seeking financial penalties (lump sums and daily payments)
expectations.evidence: "8 July 2026: referral to the Court of Justice of the EU (IP/26/1499) of Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands... seeking lump-sum and daily penalty payments"

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands has since transposed: its Cyberbeveiligingswet entered into force August 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: "The Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw)... entered into force on 15 August 2026... replacing the Wbni"

expectations.text: References the earlier procedural steps: letters of formal notice November 2024 and reasoned opinions May 2025
expectations.evidence: "28 November 2024: letters of formal notice... 7 May 2025: reasoned opinions"

expectations.text: Advises companies in untransposed states to prepare against the directive text rather than wait
expectations.evidence: "Do not treat that as a reason to wait... prepare against the directive text: Art. 20 governance, the Art. 21(2)(a)-(j) measures..."
